[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Create an enjoyable morning routine: Incorporate activities that bring joy, like listening to music or practicing yoga.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Gradually add new habits: Introduce new habits one at a time to prevent overwhelm.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Be kind to yourself: Don't be too hard on yourself if you miss a day or two.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Celebrate small wins: Acknowledge and celebrate small victories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Be flexible: Adjust the routine as needed but maintain core elements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Use technology to your advantage: Utilize apps like Habitica, HabitBull, or Alarmy to track progress.
